title: Private Markets, Opto-Ready — Head of Engineering Field Guide
description: Interactive textbook for an Opto Investments Head of Engineering interview: Opto Build/Fundraise/Manage deep dive, recruiter-claim verifier, private-markets map, J-curve & pacing simulators, player atlas (Opto vs iCapital/CAIS), Opto engineering-blog decoder (bitemporal data, backfilling, internal tools), operating-leverage simulator, 2025–26 news briefs with copy-ready questions for Ryan VanGorder & Matt Reed, searchable glossary, flashcards and quiz. Includes printable TEXTBOOK.md and night-before cheatsheet.

title: Inside Legal AI — Systems Design Field Guide
description: An interactive, evidence-labeled systems-design field guide to Docusign IAM, EveOS, Harvey, CoCounsel Legal, and Legora aOS. Compare feature matrices, trace request flows, inspect rough architectures and data pipelines, and practice interview-ready redesigns with public claims separated from engineering reconstructions.

title: Eliquis, Modern Blood Thinners & Alcohol: Inside Your Brain
description: Plain-English interactive brain cutaway, microscopic vessel patch lab, clotting-cascade family explorer, hangover-vs-bleed unmasker, and 48-hour body simulator explaining why mixing DOACs (Eliquis, Xarelto, Pradaxa) with alcohol cuts both clotting safety brakes inside a rigid skull.

title: Run the Books: Fogline AI — Accounting Flight Simulator
description: Operate a fictional AI startup's books across 16 interactive demos: double-entry, ingestion & dedupe, reconciliation, deferred revenue, invoicing, consolidation, month-end close, safe agent execution, idempotent retries, automation policy, and reading business metrics critically.

title: Inside the Coagulation Lab
description: Interactive 11-bench tour of the listed panel: Vitamin D 25-Hydroxy (LC-MS/MS), Lupus Anticoagulant Reflex (PTT-LA/dRVVT), APS panel (aPTT/PT/INR/TT/hexagonal/aCL+β2GP1), Protein S antigen (total & free), Factor V Leiden PCR, Protein S functional, Antithrombin activity, Protein C antigen, Factor II activity, Protein C functional — plus the synthesis Interpretation Report. Generic educational content only, no personal data.

title: Thin Film Lab: ALD vs PVD
description: Start from zero: why anyone deposits nanometer-thin films (chips, lenses, implants, crisp packets), then three interactive labs on ALD vs PVD — self-limiting reactions, trench conformality, and real growth curves.

title: Nobel Prize Explainer
description: A friendly interactive gallery of the 2023–2025 Nobel Prizes, with approachable exhibits for understanding each breakthrough.

title: Tabby Slink
description: A brown mackerel tabby on a low nocturnal stalk: planted paws, a hovering step, tail-tip freezes, and a coat of broken stripes in moonlight.

title: Interactive Particle Vector Field
description: Real-time canvas flow field with simplex noise, velocity vectors, cursor gravitational attraction, and customizable palettes.

title: Sorting Algorithm Visualizer
description: Step-by-step visualizer comparing Tim Sort, Quicksort, Mergesort, Heapsort, Shell Sort, Radix Sort (LSD), Bubble, and Selection sort with real-time metrics.

title: Cellular Automata Lab
description: Conway's Game of Life, Brian's Brain, and HighLife simulators with interactive brush drawing, preset oscillators, and spaceship launchers.

title: Lower Leg Circulation & DVT Visualizer
description: Explore how leg movement drives the calf-muscle pump and one-way vein valves, compare healthy vs damaged valves, and see why clot healing takes ~3 months.
